call_sites: reckon/mcp.py:3538 roadmap tool registration wraps _roadmap_deadline_tool() in _refuse_when_stale
reckon/mcp.py:2061 _roadmap loads the stored answer for the call's shape
reckon/mcp.py:2092 _roadmap stores every composition with its held flag
reckon/mcp_deadlines.py:520 _read_joining_running passes wait_limit and on_timeout into _await_body

findings.text: non-blocking: assert stale['shape'] == _shape() derives both sides from mcp_module._roadmap_snapshot_scope (which calls _roadmap_shape), so a defect in shape construction moves both sides together and the assertion stays true; it can only catch a dropped or unread shape field. The shape-identity behaviour is independently guarded at :336-357, but this line adds no guard of its own.

non-blocking: on_timeout is set to the raw _fallback, while the presence check at :505 goes through _safe_fallback, which exists so that 'a fallback never becomes the read's failure' (:454-466). An exception raised while building the stale answer at the timeout therefore propagates out of _await_body instead of degrading to the storage-slow result the read would have reported.

non-blocking: the presence-check half of 6a5b1d308 is unguarded by any test — reverting :505-507 to build the full answer up front leaves every case in tests/test_a_slow_roadmap_read_serves_its_last_snapshot.py green, so only the keep-bound half of that follow-up has a failing condition.

item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit: 4065e0312 adds the per-shape record, held flag, roadmap_snapshot_last/roadmap_stale_answer and the reserve/on_timeout path; b5d9a9be0 makes the fallback resolve _run_scoped_read_root so a run-scoped read has no stored answer; 6a5b1d308 makes the keep bound count docs roots by mtime and splits answer presence from answer construction. Five files, all declared.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when names tests/test_a_slow_roadmap_read_serves_its_last_snapshot.py with three existing files under the literal -n 8 command; head-gate.log records '39 passed in 46.46s' with EXIT=0 at 6a5b1d308 and base-gate.log '9 failed, 30 passed' with EXIT=1 at a 3df04d103 scratch tree, and I re-ran the three cases the follow-ups answer (test_one_tree_keeps, test_a_run_scoped_read_is_not, test_a_read_past_its_reserve) at 6a5b1d308: 3 passed. All eight cases section 56 lists are present at tests/test_a_slow_roadmap_read_serves_its_last_snapshot.py:201-470.
item_verdicts.goal: The goal is to store every composition as its tree's and shape's last snapshot and answer a read held past its reserve from it, marked stale; reckon/roadmap_snapshot.py:625 roadmap_snapshot_store now writes every composition with a held flag, reckon/roadmap_snapshot.py:581 roadmap_snapshot_last returns the newest record by tree and shape, and reckon/mcp.py:2017 _roadmap_stale_answer returns it marked, so the goal is met.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it names the three commits, the head/base/revert gate logs, baseline_suite 9 failed with pytest node ids and after_suite 0 failed at 6a5b1d308, the reserve constant and its override, and evidence_inputs that correctly attributes eight of the nine base failures to the absent _roadmap_deadline_tool helper and the ninth to roadmap_snapshot_store() not yet taking shape.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The declared paths are reckon/roadmap_snapshot.py, reckon/mcp_deadlines.py, reckon/mcp.py, the new test file and one evidence fragment (plus an unused docs/figures path); git diff 3df04d103..6a5b1d308 changes exactly five files, all inside that set.

justifications.durability: Reverting 6a5b1d308 reddens test_one_tree_keeps_its_record_for_every_shape_it_holds and reverting b5d9a9be0 reddens test_a_run_scoped_read_is_not_answered_from_the_mounted_tree (each 1 failed, 8 passed, EXIT=1), but tests/test_a_slow_roadmap_read_serves_its_last_snapshot.py:231 compares stale['shape'] against _shape(), both derived from _roadmap_snapshot_scope, and the presence-check half of 6a5b1d308 has no assertion.
justifications.evidence: head-gate.log ends '39 passed' EXIT=0 and base-gate.log '9 failed, 30 passed' EXIT=1, but eight of the nine base failures are AttributeError from the new helper at tests/test_a_slow_roadmap_read_serves_its_last_snapshot.py:134, so the delta measures an absent API as well as the behaviour.
justifications.fit: The additions follow the surrounding idiom of reckon/roadmap_snapshot.py:554-625 and reckon/mcp_deadlines.py:454-520, and no added symbol carries a plan, sprint or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/mcp.py:2091 stores with held=(settled[0]==key) and reckon/mcp.py:2017 builds the stale answer, matching every sentence of section 56.
justifications.reuse: A capability search over reckon/ found no other owner of a last-stored-answer-by-shape fallback; the change extends reckon/roadmap_snapshot.py and reuses _INFLIGHT_READS and _read_joining_running at reckon/mcp_deadlines.py:487 rather than adding a second registry.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 3df04d103..6a5b1d308 lists five files, every one named in the node's declared write paths.
